headline.title: Google DeepMind and A24 announce first-of-its-kind research partnership
headline.summary: Google DeepMind has partnered with A24 to explore the intersection of artificial intelligence and film production, marking a unique collaboration in the entertainment industry. The partnership aims to leverage AI technology to enhance storytelling and creative processes in filmmaking.

articles.title: The browser wars aren’t about search anymore — here are the best alternatives to Chrome and Safari
articles.summary: The article provides an overview of various alternative web browsers that are emerging as competitors to Chrome and Safari. It highlights the features and advantages of these browsers, emphasizing the shift in focus from search capabilities to overall browsing experience.

articles.title: Pragmatic FDT, and predictors as game theory
articles.summary: Bentham's Bulldog critiques Functional Decision Theory (FDT) in a recent blog post, highlighting the divide between its popularity among rationalists and skepticism from academic decision theorists. The article emphasizes the limited acceptance of FDT within the academic community, suggesting that its proponents are few and far between.

articles.title: A behind-the-scenes look at Midjourney’s medical scanner leaves many questions unanswered
articles.summary: Midjourney has unveiled a behind-the-scenes video of its dunk-tank ultrasound scanner, aimed at providing affordable, detailed, and radiation-free medical imaging. However, the company has yet to provide substantial evidence of the scanner's effectiveness.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unionization Talks Are Off to a Rocky Start
articles.summary: Negotiations for unionization at Google DeepMind faced challenges as employees expressed dissatisfaction with executives' lack of meaningful engagement in discussions. The talks, held on Wednesday, highlighted ongoing tensions between staff and management regarding union representation.

articles.title: Anthropic wants to develop its own drugs
articles.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Science, an AI workbench designed to consolidate various scientific tools and datasets into a single platform, enhancing the research process for scientists. This announcement was made during the "AI for Science" event, highlighting Anthropic's ongoing commitment to advancing AI applications in scientific research.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg tells staff that AI agents haven’t progressed as quickly as he’d hoped
articles.summary: Mark Zuckerberg informed Meta staff during an internal meeting that the company's AI development has not progressed as quickly as he had hoped. He expressed concerns about the pace of advancements in AI agents.

articles.title: Agent4cs: A Multi-agent System for Code Summarization in Large Hierarchical Codebases
articles.summary: Agent4cs is a multi-agent system designed to improve code summarization in large hierarchical codebases by leveraging the interdependencies and hierarchical information within repositories. This approach aims to enhance understanding of complex code structures, which are often poorly documented and challenging to navigate.

articles.title: SimWorlds: A Multi-Agent System for Dynamic 3D Scene Creation
articles.summary: SimWorlds is a new multi-agent system designed to create dynamic 3D scenes from natural language input, addressing the limitations of existing systems that primarily generate static outputs. The system aims to produce editable content featuring fluid dynamics, particle emissions, and moving mechanisms, which could enhance training data for video generation and embodied AI applications.

articles.title: A$^{2}$utoLPBench: An Auto-Generated, Agent-Friendly LP Benchmark via Inverse-KKT Construction
articles.summary: The article introduces A$^{2}$utoLPBench, a new benchmark designed for evaluating LLM-driven agents on linear programming problems generated through an inverse-KKT construction method. This approach addresses the limitations of static, hand-labeled datasets by providing a dynamic and scalable framework for testing.

articles.title: Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis in Non-Manhattan Environments
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced SPG-Layout, a new text-driven framework designed to improve 3D indoor scene synthesis in non-Manhattan environments, addressing limitations in existing methods that struggle with non-orthogonal spatial relationships. The framework aims to enhance object layout patterns and reduce geometric violations, thereby increasing physical fidelity in synthesized scenes.

articles.title: Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics Enable Complete and Scalable $\mathrm{E}(3)$-Equivariant Networks
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced SpinGTP, a new method that enhances the expressivity of $\mathrm{E}(3)$-equivariant networks for 3D atomistic system modeling by addressing the limitations of the Gaunt Tensor Product (GTP). This approach aims to improve scalability while maintaining the ability to capture antisymmetric paths, which were previously overlooked.
